name: showme
description: This JavaScript file provides a function called `showMe()` that allows you to show or hide a specific element on a webpage based on a date comparison.
author: Zach Schneider

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist && cp -R src/* dist/
scripts.lint: eslint . --ext .js --ignore-pattern dist --ignore-pattern node_modules --no-eslintrc --env browser --env node --env jest --parser-options ecmaVersion:latest,sourceType:module --rule no-undef:error --rule no-unused-vars:warn
